verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a public REST API covering CRM objects, for example creating contacts with POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts and managing custom object records individually or in batches. The docs also describe date-based versioning, a maintained deprecation policy, and per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.0.1 specs. Probes returning 404 at root-level llms.txt and openapi.json paths do not contradict this, because the docs place llms.txt under /docs/ and publish specs inline on each endpoint page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API, and a single aggregated, discoverable OpenAPI spec at a well-known path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To create one contact, make a `POST` request to `/crm/v3/objects/contacts`.
You can retrieve custom object records individually or in batches.
When a new date version is released, the previous version continues to work until its end-of-life date, giving you time to migrate.
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
